archetypes.name: research-parity
archetypes.rationale: The migration replaces several shell contracts with new Python implementations that need behavior parity review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/research.py and python/research_eval.py against the documented shell contracts in the plan. Focus on exit codes, stdout/KV grammar, sidecar shapes, reason tokens, and fail-soft paths. Pay special attention to citation validation network safety and eval harness smoke/full-run behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: callsite-cutover
archetypes.rationale: The change deletes many shell helpers and rewires scattered runtime call sites.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace every production call site that formerly invoked the retired research or eval scripts. Verify each now calls python3 python/cli.py with the correct domain, verb, flags, and Bash array handling. Check docs and harness pins for stale or malformed command strings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-replacement
archetypes.rationale: Large shell harnesses were replaced by two pytest modules and Makefile aliases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Assess whether python/test_research.py and python/test_research_eval.py cover the retired harness contracts enough for this slice. Look for missing edge cases in quiet fd-3 routing, planner boundaries, findings rendering, citation reason tokens, structured reviewer validation, and eval-set schema checks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
